startingCard.title: ‘Game of Thrones’ airs for the first time
startingCard.subtitle: American fantasy drama television series
startingCard.fact: Game of Thrones is an American fantasy drama television series created by David Benioff and D.

cards.title: Scuderia Ferrari is founded
cards.subtitle: Formula 1 team
cards.fact: Ferrari S.p.A, currently competing as Scuderia Ferrari HP, is the racing division of luxury Italian auto manufacturer Ferrari and the racing team that competes in Formula One racing.

cards.title: ‘ER’ airs for the first time
cards.subtitle: American medical drama television series
cards.fact: ER is an American medical drama television series created by Michael Crichton that aired on NBC from September 19, 1994, to April 2, 2009, with a total of 331 episodes spanning 15 seasons.

cards.title: Computer is invented
cards.subtitle: Invented by Charles Babbage
cards.fact: A computer is a machine that can be programmed to automatically carry out sequences of arithmetic or logical operations (computation).

cards.title: Western Xia is established
cards.subtitle: Historical state
cards.fact: The Western Xia or the Xi Xia (Chinese: 西夏; pinyin: Xī Xià; Wade–Giles: Hsi1 Hsia4), officially the Kingdom of the Great Xia of the White and Lofty (Tangut: 𗴂𗹭𘜶𗴲𗂧) or Great Xia (大夏; Dà Xià; Ta4 Hsia4), also known as the Tangut Empire, was a Tangut-led imperial dynasty of China that existed from 1038 to 1227 AD.

cards.title: ‘Malcolm in the Middle’ airs for the first time
cards.subtitle: American television sitcom
cards.fact: Malcolm in the Middle is an American television sitcom created by Linwood Boomer for the Fox Broadcasting Company.

cards.title: ‘Sci-Hub’ launches
cards.subtitle: Website
cards.fact: Sci-Hub is a shadow library that provides free access to millions of research papers, regardless of copyright, by bypassing publishers' paywalls in various ways.

cards.title: Hunter first flies
cards.subtitle: Aircraft by Hawker Siddeley
cards.fact: The Hawker Hunter is a transonic British jet-powered fighter aircraft that was developed by Hawker Aircraft for the Royal Air Force (RAF) during the late 1940s and early 1950s.

cards.title: Charles Manson dies
cards.subtitle: American criminal and cult leader
cards.fact: Charles Milles Manson was an American criminal, cult leader, and musician who was the founder of the Manson Family.

cards.title: ‘American Horror Story’ airs for the first time
cards.subtitle: American anthology horror television series
cards.fact: American Horror Story (AHS) is an American horror anthology television series created by Ryan Murphy and Brad Falchuk for the cable network FX.

cards.title: Siege of Budapest takes place
cards.subtitle: Battle in World War II
cards.fact: The Siege of Budapest or Battle of Budapest was the 50-day-long encirclement by Soviet and Romanian forces of the Hungarian capital of Budapest, near the end of World War II.

cards.title: ‘Great Teacher Onizuka’ begins
cards.subtitle: Japanese manga series
cards.fact: Great Teacher Onizuka, abbreviated as GTO, is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Tooru Fujisawa.

cards.title: Mesa Verde National Park is completed
cards.subtitle: U.S. national park in Colorado
cards.fact: Mesa Verde National Park is a national park of the United States and UNESCO World Heritage Site located in Montezuma County, Colorado, and the only World Heritage Site in Colorado.

cards.title: Andreas Brehme dies
cards.subtitle: German association football player
cards.fact: Andreas "Andi" Brehme was a German professional football player and coach.

cards.title: Vakil Mosque is completed
cards.subtitle: Mosque in Shiraz, Iranian national heritage site
cards.fact: The Vakil Mosque is a Shi'ite mosque, located in Shiraz, in the province of Fars, in southern Iran.

cards.title: Basilica of San Lorenzo is completed
cards.subtitle: Church in Florence, Italy
cards.fact: The Basilica di San Lorenzo is one of the largest churches of Florence, Italy, situated at the centre of the main market district of the city, and it is the burial place of all the principal members of the Medici family from Cosimo il Vecchio to Cosimo III.

cards.title: Battle of Saule takes place
cards.subtitle: Battle in Livonian Crusade
cards.fact: The Battle of Saule was fought on 22 September 1236, between the Livonian Brothers of the Sword and pagan troops of Samogitians and Semigallians.

cards.title: ‘Dune’ is released
cards.subtitle: Film directed by Denis Villeneuve
cards.fact: Dune is a 2021 American epic space opera film co-produced and directed by Denis Villeneuve, who co-wrote the screenplay with Jon Spaihts and Eric Roth.

cards.title: Mikoyan MiG-35 first flies
cards.subtitle: Aircraft by Russian Aircraft Corporation MiG
cards.fact: The Mikoyan MiG-35 is a Russian multirole fighter that is designed by Mikoyan, a division of the United Aircraft Corporation (UAC).

cards.title: ‘Electra’ premieres
cards.subtitle: Play by Euripides
cards.fact: Euripides' Electra is a tragedy probably written in the mid 410s BC, likely before 413 BC.

cards.title: ‘Total Overdose’ releases
cards.subtitle: Video game by Deadline Games
cards.fact: Total Overdose: A Gunslinger's Tale in Mexico is an open world third-person shooter video game developed by Deadline Games and published by SCi Games for Microsoft Windows, PlayStation 2 and Xbox.

cards.title: Los Angeles Dodgers is founded
cards.subtitle: MLB franchise
cards.fact: The Los Angeles Dodgers are an American professional baseball team based in Los Angeles.

cards.title: ‘It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia’ airs for the first time
cards.subtitle: American comedy television series
cards.fact: It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia, also commonly referred to as Always Sunny or IASIP, is an American sitcom created by Rob Mac and co-developed by Glenn Howerton for FX, currently airing on FXX.

cards.title: War of the Fifth Coalition begins
cards.subtitle: Conflict
cards.fact: The War of the Fifth Coalition was a European conflict in 1809 that was part of the Napoleonic Wars and the Coalition Wars.

cards.title: Extra launches
cards.subtitle: Brand of chewing gum
cards.fact: Extra is a brand of sugarfree chewing gum produced by the Wrigley Company in several markets in the world with different variations.

cards.title: ‘Bathory’ is released
cards.subtitle: Album by Bathory
cards.fact: Bathory is the debut studio album by Swedish extreme metal band Bathory.

cards.title: Rapping movement begins
cards.subtitle: Art movement
cards.fact: Rapping is an artistic form of vocal delivery and emotive expression that incorporates "rhyme, rhythmic speech, and [commonly] street vernacular".

cards.title: ‘Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them’ is published
cards.subtitle: Book by J. K. Rowling
cards.fact: Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them is a 2001 guide book written by British author J.

cards.title: ‘Poppy Playtime’ releases
cards.subtitle: Video game by Mob Entertainment
cards.fact: Poppy Playtime is an episodic puzzle survival horror video game series first developed and published in October 2021 by American indie developer Mob Entertainment.

cards.title: Western Wei begins
cards.subtitle: Dynasty
cards.fact: Wei, known in historiography as the Western Wei, was an imperial dynasty of China that followed the disintegration of the Northern Wei.

cards.title: Portuguese Angola is established
cards.subtitle: Colony
cards.fact: In southwestern Africa, Portuguese Angola was a historical colony of the Portuguese Empire (1575–1951), the overseas province Portuguese West Africa of Estado Novo Portugal (1951–1972), and the State of Angola of the Portuguese Empire (1972–1975).
